name: Barbara
bio: Archetype: Skill Transfer, Card-Star Up. ⌽ Decent skill damage and can provide shielding ⌽ Ult grants a strong, team-wide, long-lasting shield. ⌽ While Ult is in effect, Barbara's skills randomly change into allies' skills, and she gains Moxie every turn start. ⌽ During this period, you also gain a special card that doesn't consume AP every turn start. Using this card will raise the star level of the skill used before it by 1 and lower the star level of the skill used after it by 1.
